thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: elevated 5xx + timeouts on inference-gateway after a deploy to prod. p95 jumped from ~120ms to ~3.2s, p99 ~8.1s over the last 5m. Affected route(s): /v1/generate, /v1/chat/stream. Pager: @maria (oncall).

maria: On it — checking dashboards (latency, error-rate, kvcache). I have the oncall runbook open.

devon: Joining. Which deploy ID/commit pushed?

aj: That was canary -> full rollout at 13:42 UTC, commit abc1234 (service: inference-gateway). I see a spike in upstream timeouts to runtime-backend around 13:48.

maria: ok capturing traces. Can someone paste the last few gateway logs?

aj: paste: ```
2026-04-06T13:48:05Z inference-gateway error: upstream timeout (context deadline exceeded) req=abcd1234
2026-04-06T13:48:06Z inference-gateway warn: request queue depth=128 workerpool=pool-7
2026-04-06T13:48:07Z runtime-backend error: conn reset by peer
```

devon: dashboards show spike concentrated in us-west-2 (p99 ~12s), other regions smaller. Error type is 504/gateway-timeout and a number of 5xx from runtime. Could be a regression that increases backend latency under certain sequence lengths.

samantha: Are we seeing kvcache evictions or a config change? I see a change in a timeout flag in the deploy diff: `BACKEND_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS` lowered from 10000 -> 3000 in the canary.

maria: if timeout lowered, that would explain earlier cutoffs. But p95 also rose drastically, not just 5xx count. Might be extra CPU or blocking path.

aj: I'm prepared to roll back if we want. Suggest immediate rollback to v2026-04-06-1150 (previous stable) while we triage. Any objections?

devon: +1 rollback. Traffic impacted and customers seeing errors. Rollback now.

maria: @deploy-bot please start rollback to v2026-04-06-1150. Notify SRE when done.

deploy-bot: Rolling back inference-gateway: start -> v2026-04-06-1150. Estimated completion 4m. Updating service, draining pods, deploying old revision... (reacted :eyes:)

incident-bot: Customer-impact summary: error-rate ~3.8% over last 10m, increased 5xx from 0.2% baseline. Affected: hosted API customers on us-west-2, some timed out streams. Severity: P2 (customer API degradation).

aj: after rollback starting to see error-rate drop in metrics stream. p95 down to ~180ms within 2m of rollback, p99 trending down to ~300ms.

maria: Confirming logs show decreased `context deadline exceeded` entries. Can we leave rollback in place and keep canary blocked until root cause?

devon: Agreed — block that commit from re-rolling until postmortem. I'll annotate the PR.

leo: I'm taking the follow-up (postmortem owner). I'll pull logs and do a binary search on the changeset (especially the timeout flag and any sync/await changes). Preliminary report in ~2 hours, full postmortem tomorrow.

samantha: Noted — will add the config flag (BACKEND_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS) to the suspect list and test reproducer with long sequence requests.

maria: Handing off oncall to @leo for next steps and postmortem. I'll update status page and ping CS for customer comms. Thanks for fast responses. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Rollback complete. All inference-gateway pods running v2026-04-06-1150. Health checks passing.

aj: Metrics stable: error-rate ~0.25% (baseline), p95 ~125ms, p99 ~260ms. Looks normal.

incident-bot: Incident closed — rollback mitigated the regression. Postmortem owner: leo. Action items: 1) block re-deploy of commit abc1234, 2) triage timeout flag change, 3) add automated canary gate for backend timeout regressions.

maria: filing follow-up tickets and adding initial notes to the incident board. Closing chat.

leo: Taking ownership. Will ping this thread with findings.

pagerbot: Pager cleared for this incident. Good job team. :white_check_mark:
